prompt.title: Create a GRE Word Helper Firefox Extension
prompt.description: Create a Firefox extension that helps users learn GRE vocabulary by highlighting words on web pages and showing their meanings in tooltips, without modifying the original page content. All necessary files and folders will be automatically created based on this prompt.

core_functionality: Scan web pages for GRE vocabulary words
Highlight matching words with a yellow background
Show word meanings in tooltips on hover
Display a count of GRE words found on the page
Preserve original page content - do not modify or replace text nodes
technical_requirements: Use manifest v2 for Firefox extension compatibility
Implement content scripts for page scanning
Use browser storage for extension state
Create a popup interface for user controls
Include a comprehensive wordlist.js file with GRE vocabulary and meanings (critical dependency)
Automatically generate and place icon files in the icons directory
Automatically move wordlist.js to the js/ directory
user_experience: No modification of original page content

critical_dependencies.description: Contains the GRE vocabulary dictionary with words and their meanings
critical_dependencies.importance: Critical - Extension cannot function without this file
critical_dependencies.location: Must be placed in the js/ directory
critical_dependencies.input_description: User must provide the wordlist.js file containing the GRE vocabulary dictionary

file_handling.move_operation: Copy the file to js/ directory and verify the move
file_handling.verification: Check if file exists in js/ directory after move

generation_instructions.verification: Check if all PNG files exist and have correct dimensions

implementation_steps.reasoning: Set up the basic directory structure for the extension
implementation_steps.verification: Check if all required directories exist
Check if manifest.json exists and has correct content

implementation_steps.reasoning: Automatically generate and place icon files for the extension
steps: Execute conversion script to generate PNG files
Verify all PNG files exist and have correct dimensions
implementation_steps.verification: Check if all icon files exist and are properly sized

implementation_steps.reasoning: Move wordlist.js to the correct location
implementation_steps.location: Must be placed in js/ directory
steps: Create js directory if it doesn't exist
Verify the file was moved successfully
implementation_steps.verification: Check if wordlist.js exists in js/ directory

implementation_steps.reasoning: Implement page scanning and word highlighting without modifying original content
constraints: Do not modify or replace text nodes
Use CSS for highlighting instead of DOM manipulation
implementation_steps.verification: Check if content.js exists and has correct functionality

implementation_steps.reasoning: Provide user controls and word count display
implementation_steps.verification: Check if popup files exist and have correct content

implementation_steps.reasoning: Ensure tooltips are readable and properly positioned
implementation_steps.verification: Check if tooltip.css exists and has correct styles

error_handling.content_script: Handle cases where page scanning fails or takes too long
error_handling.popup: Show appropriate error messages when communication fails
error_handling.storage: Provide fallback values when storage is unavailable
error_handling.wordlist: Verify wordlist.js is loaded and contains valid data before scanning
error_handling.icons: Verify all icon files exist and are properly sized
error_handling.file_operations: Handle file movement and creation errors

self_verification: Check if word highlighting is working correctly
Verify wordlist.js is properly loaded and accessible
Verify original page content is preserved
Check all icon files are present and properly sized
Verify all files are in their correct locations

reasoning_types.content_preservation: Ensuring original page content is not modified

implementation_notes.folder_creation: All necessary folders will be automatically created
implementation_notes.file_generation: All files except wordlist.js will be automatically generated
implementation_notes.user_input: Only wordlist.js requires user input - all other files will be created automatically
implementation_notes.icon_generation: Icons will be automatically generated and placed in the icons directory
implementation_notes.directory_structure: The following directory structure will be automatically created: icons/, js/, popup/, css/

file_handling.wordlist.js: The file will be automatically moved to the js/ directory
file_handling.icons: SVG will be converted to PNG in all required sizes
file_handling.verification: All file operations will be verified
